newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian electricity consumption falls in December.
newsitem.headline: Italian electricity consumption falls in December.

text.p: Italian electricity consumption fell 0.4 percent year-on-year in December, utility company Enel said in provisional data released on Tuesday.
There were 20 working days last month against 18 in December 1995 and Enel said that taking this into account, electricity demand actually shrunk by 1.8 percent.
Enel said in a statement that electricity consumption rose 0.5 percent in 1996 as a whole compared to 1995 levels.
However 1996 was a leap year and Enel said that if the additional day was not taken into account, consumption rose by just 0.2 percent.
